title: File the payment bug
task: Find the discussion about the payment double-charge bug in the #payments Slack channel, file an issue for it in the acme/payments-api repository, and post the issue link back in #payments.

title: Customer support: help one customer
task: You are handling the open support conversation with customer 1001. Read the conversation, look up their record, resolve their issue about the late order, and reply to them.

title: AI organization: manager delegates to a worker
task: Prepare the incident summary for the payments double-charge bug. Delegate the reading of Slack thread 18291 in #payments to a worker agent, giving it only what it needs, and have it return a three-sentence summary. Then file an issue in acme/payments-api titled 'Incident summary: double charge on retry' with that summary.

title: Fix and deploy the payment bug
task: The double-charge-on-retry bug in acme/payments-api has a fix in PR #481. Review the PR and, if checks pass, merge it to deploy the fix.
